definitions.explanation: In linguistics, the smallest unit of language that carries meaning. A word may consist of one morpheme or several, such as a root plus prefixes and suffixes.

examples.japanese: {形態素|けいたいそ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最小単位|さいしょうたんい}だ。
examples.english: A morpheme is the smallest unit of meaning.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{形態素|けいたいそ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}けられる→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧。
examples.english: This word can be divided into three morphemes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{形態素|けいたいそ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分割|ぶんかつ}する→分割する：21140_bunkatsusuru⟧⟦{解析|かいせき}→解析：16075_kaiseki⟧⟦ソフト→ソフト：01532_sofuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}く→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Software that breaks Japanese text into morphemes is widely used.

notes:
A technical term in linguistics and natural language processing. In Japanese computing, {形態素解析|けいたいそかいせき} (morphological analysis) is a fundamental step in processing text, since Japanese is written without spaces between words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {形態素解析|けいたいそかいせき}: morphological analysis
- ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧{形態素|けいたいそ}: free morpheme
- ⟦{拘束|こうそく}→拘束：02803_kousoku⟧{形態素|けいたいそ}: bound morpheme

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧: word — may consist of one or more morphemes
- {語幹|ごかん}: stem; root — the core part of a word to which endings attach
